info.title: Chest Tracker API
info.description:
REST API for **Chest Tracker** — a clan chest tracking tool and analytics platform.

The API covers the full lifecycle of running a clan: administering members and their state, recording and aggregating chest readings into per-day/per-source/per-member breakdowns, queueing background scans of in-game data, refreshing invites, and — when the Tournaments add-on is enabled — uploading and analyzing weekly tournament results.

**Authentication.** Every endpoint outside of the authentication route requires a JWT bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Obtain one via `POST /v1/authenticate`; member-scoped tokens can be derived via `POST /v1/impersonate`.

**Authorization.** A five-tier role hierarchy is enforced server-side: `user` → `member` → `manager` → `owner`. Each endpoint lists the role it requires. All data access is automatically scoped to the caller's clan via the authenticated token.

**List endpoints** share a common query-parameter contract for `filter`, `sort`, `paginate`, `include`, and `fields`. See each endpoint for the supported relations and fields.

**Versioning.** All endpoints are served under `/v1`. Older non-versioned paths are transparently rewritten to `/v1` allowing for endpoint versioning due to backwards compatibility updates.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Issue and manage JWT bearer tokens. Authenticate with email + password, swap a user-scoped token for a member-scoped one via impersonation, or clear an active impersonation back to the underlying user token. The tokens issued here are accepted by every other endpoint in this API.

tags.name: Members
tags.description: Read and modify clan members. Manage display name, rank, status (`new` / `inactive` / `exempt` / `vacation` / `rotation in` / `rotation out` / `administrative` / `left`), notes, aliases, avatar, the four talent-tree levels, might/hero levels, gold pass flag, tracker-account linkage, and main/alt relationships. Supports bulk restore for soft-deleted members and member merging.

tags.name: Chests
tags.description: Submit chest readings (single or bulk) and report on the collected data. Aggregates available by date window include per-member point totals, chest counts, per-type/per-source breakdowns, daily time series, and overall totals (chests, crypts, citadels, ancients, epics).

tags.name: Dashboards
tags.description: Pre-aggregated dashboards for the authenticated user's clan. Returns the newest and top-by-might members, distributions across might / hero / Gold Pass and the four troop levels (guards, monsters, specialists, engineers), plus the date-windowed chest summary (top members by points and by chests, breakdown by source/type, daily series, totals).

tags.name: Definitions
tags.description: Catalog of chest and item definitions used to score chests. Lists the global definition set and lets a clan manager create per-clan **overrides** (custom point values, etc.) or reset a clan's overrides back to the global defaults.

tags.name: Invites
tags.description: Invite flow for joining a clan. Generate a single-use invite key, look it up by key for the public claim flow, accept an invite to bind the inviting user to the clan, and revoke or refresh pending invites.

tags.name: Queue
tags.description: Priority scan queue. Members may manually request a scan for their clan (subject to a 2-hour cooldown, or 30 minutes with the Rapid Pulls add-on), or see if there is an existing queue request pending for the clan.

tags.name: Tournaments
tags.description: Tournament uploads, breakdowns, and per-entry edits. **Requires the Tournaments add-on.** Upload weekly result sets (deduplicating by member name and fuzzy-matching to existing members), view per-member rankings over a date window with per-type/per-date sub-totals, and edit individual entries to link an unrecognized name to a member or correct points/might/hero/vault flags.

type.description: Job type for this entry. Defaults to "chests".

from.description: In-game name of the clan member the chest was awarded to. Matched against member names and aliases on import.

name.description: Display name of the chest as it appears in the source.

source.description: Source the chest dropped from (event, squad, rally, etc.). Used to resolve the chest definition.

time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the chest was generated in-game.

quantity.description: Number of chests this entry represents. Defaults to 1.

reward.description: Reward the chest gave when opened, read off the game's open message. A map of lowercase resource/item slug to amount, resolved by the runner; an unmapped reward stays keyed by its numeric game id.

externalId.description: The game's item id for this chest type, read off the wire. Matched against definition externalIds before the name and source strings, and recorded on the definition when a chest creates or first matches one.

points.description: Clan-specific point value that supersedes the global definition's `points`. Range 0-999999.

applyTo.description: Apply the override to all definitions that share the target's `type` or `source`, rather than just the single definition.

name.description: In-game display name for this row. Used when `externalId` finds no member: matched against existing members (exact name, then alias, then fuzzy match). A row matching neither is saved with a null `memberId`, named by whichever of the two was given, and can be linked later via PATCH /tournaments/entries/:id.

points.description: Points scored by this member in the tournament.

isVaultCreated.description: Whether the member created a vault for this tournament. Defaults to false.

type.description: Tournament type as displayed in-game (e.g. "Ancients Treasure", "Ragnarok", "Olympus"). Combined with `date` and the caller's clan to identify the tournament; uploads for an existing `(type, date)` are merged into it.

date.description: Tournament date (the day the tournament ended), ISO-8601.

entries.description: Per-member result rows for the tournament. Rows are deduplicated by `name` before insertion. Omit when uploading only the clan reward.

reward.description: The clan's earned reward for placing, keyed by resource type, for prefilling distribution. Merged onto the existing `(type, date)` tournament.

id.description: Identifier of the reward pool this payout came from. Stable across a distribution run, so the same pool lines up across every entry.

label.description: Display name of the reward being paid out.

amount.description: Whole units paid to this entry from the pool. Rewards are indivisible, so fractional amounts are rejected.

id.description: UUID of the tournament entry being paid. Must belong to the tournament in the path.

rewards.description: This entry's payout from each pool. Replaces the entry's existing rewards outright; an empty array clears them.

entries.description: Payouts to write, one element per entry. Every entry named must belong to the tournament in the path, or the whole request is rejected and nothing is written.

memberId.description: UUID of the clan member to link this entry to. When transitioning from an unlinked (null `memberId`) entry, all other unlinked entries in the same clan that share this entry's `name` are reassigned, and the prior name is appended to the member's aliases if it differs from their display name.

name.description: In-game display name for this row. Overrides the originally scanned name.

rank.description: Leaderboard rank for this entry (1-based). Overrides the position it was saved with.

isVaultCreated.description: Whether the member created a vault for this tournament.

rewards.description: Rewards paid to this entry, replacing any it already carries. Managers only — a member without manager rights is refused. Use POST /tournaments/:id/rewards to pay a whole tournament in one transaction.

isRewarded.description: Whether the rewards on this entry have been handed over in game. Managers only. Writing a new distribution through POST /tournaments/:id/rewards resets it to false.

memberId.description: Member the penalty applies to. Must belong to the caller's clan.

amount.description: Amount added to the member's target for the current cycle, in units of the clan's scoring metric.
